supplementary_findings.detail: Re-running the GFN0-xTB case with XTBPATH=/home/<user>/xtb-dist/share/xtb (instead of the default XTBPATH=/home/<user>/xtb-dist/bin) yields rc=0, ORCA TERMINATED NORMALLY and FINAL SINGLE POINT ENERGY -4.366773861540 Eh with no 'param_gfn0-xtb.txt not found' error. Confirms the case-10 verdict is a path-resolution dependency gap with a known remediation, not an unsupported software capability. Platform policy (GFN0-xTB is xTB-binary-only on the ORCA path) is deliberately UNCHANGED by this probe.

A valid ORCA 6.1.1 RHF/def2-SVP NMR single point (rc=0, normal termination, FINAL SINGLE POINT ENERGY -75.960983978583 Eh) DOES contain 'CHEMICAL SHIELDINGS (ppm)' with per-nucleus shielding tensors, yet NmrShieldingParser.parse() returns {} (0 atoms): the parser regexes target ORCA 5.x headers/rows, not ORCA 6.1 format. This does not change any of the 13 verdicts (the GFN2-xTB NMR output contains no shielding data at all), but it is a required input for T8/T17: on ORCA 6.1, even DFT NMR artifacts cannot be consumed by the current parser.
The DEFGRID3-only case energy (-75.960983978583 Eh) is identical to an explicit RHF/def2-SVP single point, confirming ORCA 6.1.1's default method is Hartree-Fock/def2-SVP.
